name: late corrections
description: An invented project in which the person takes part: a dependency, a rejected proposal, a change reported five days late, a correction of its date two days after that, and an unconfirmed report left open. Questions ask what is current, what was true on a date, and what was known on a date.

records.author: @you
records.text: The Brindle project renders its reports with the Tessel library, version 2. Tessel is what Brindle uses in production today.
records.title: Brindle report rendering

questions.question: Which library does Brindle render its reports with?

records.author: design lead
records.text: Proposal: should Brindle switch its reports from Tessel to Quarrel? Just an idea for now.

records.author: @you
records.text: Let's not. Quarrel cannot do the page layouts we need. Brindle is not switching to Quarrel.

records.author: design lead
records.text: Fine, Quarrel is off the table.

records.author: platform engineer
records.text: Heads up, I never posted this: Brindle's reports moved from Tessel to Marrow in production on May 5. Tessel is no longer used there.

records.author: @you
records.text: Thanks, I had no idea. So since May 5 production renders with Marrow.

questions.question: Which library does Brindle render its reports with now?
questions.expectedAnswer: Marrow, since the move from Tessel in production.

questions.question: Did Brindle switch to Quarrel?
questions.expectedAnswer: No. It was proposed on May 3 and rejected the same day because Quarrel cannot do the page layouts.

questions.question: Which library was Brindle using in production on May 6, 2032?
questions.expectedAnswer: Marrow: the move from Tessel happened on May 5 (as reported on May 10).

questions.question: On May 6, 2032, going by what had been said by then, which library did we believe Brindle used?
questions.expectedAnswer: Tessel. The move to Marrow was only reported on May 10.

records.author: platform engineer
records.text: Correction to what I said on the 10th: the Marrow switch in production happened on May 7, not May 5. May 5 was only the staging switch.

records.author: @you
records.text: Noted: production moved to Marrow on May 7, staging on May 5.

records.author: support engineer
records.text: A customer says their May 6 report still looked like a Tessel render. Could be a cached copy, nobody has checked.

records.author: @you
records.text: Let's not conclude anything from one report until someone checks the cache.

questions.question: When did Brindle's production move to Marrow?
questions.expectedAnswer: On May 7, 2032 (corrected on May 12; May 5 was the staging switch).

questions.question: Which library was Brindle using in production on May 6, 2032?
questions.expectedAnswer: Tessel: production moved to Marrow on May 7, per the May 12 correction.

questions.question: On May 11, 2032, going by what had been said by then, when did we believe production had moved to Marrow?
questions.expectedAnswer: May 5. The correction to May 7 came on May 12.

questions.question: Was the customer's May 6 report really rendered with Tessel?
questions.expectedAnswer: Unknown: one customer said so, it may have been a cached copy, and nobody has checked.
